title: Iconic and engine sound impressions
summary: Reviews in this topic discuss iconic sound features, engine sound character, and a few unrelated noise mentions, with praise for enjoyable or confident sound tuning but some dislike of the artificial sound experience.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the iconic sounds as fun and enjoyable and also appreciate confident engine sound along with quiet operation.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize the iconic sounds directly or describe the sound-related mode setup as poorly prioritized versus more useful customization.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention sounds or sound settings without a clear opinion, and some examples are too sparse or unrelated to infer a sentiment.

limitations: This cluster mixes several unrelated subjects, including iconic sounds, engine sound quality, cupholder quietness, stiffness described as sounding normal, and electrical sounds during phone charging.
Several undetermined fragments are too brief or context-dependent to classify beyond mentioning sounds.
The examples are a stratified sample and do not support broader claims about how common these experiences are.
